title: Dao Wounds Healed
summary: Inside the Ancient Forbidden Land the power of 'Huang' strips Ye Fan's cultivation even through the stone robe. He survives by sheltering in the Bronze Coffin and by drawing life energy from Nannan's colourful stone, which also explains why she hasn't aged. He finds a Life Spring and a divine tree whose nine fruits each hold a fragment of natural law, and learns that nine fruits and roots from the nine holy mountains are needed for true immortality medicine. He sees the Five-Coloured Altar, which he thinks is as mysterious as the Nine Dragon Coffin and might be able to take him home, and obtains the immortality medicine. Using it, he breaks the curse on his broken path, heals his Dao wounds and reaches the 2nd level of Four Poles after three months inside. When he comes out, Yin-Yang Sect disciples led by a Dragon Transformation elder ambush him with their Yin-Yang array; he fights back, and they flee.

flags: 'Kamu penggemar' throughout is a machine mistranslation of the name 'Ye Fan' (叶凡 read as 'you fan'); treated as Ye Fan.
13:37–15:40: the subs never explicitly say he eats the medicine or collects all nine fruits; the healing is shown through a breakthrough monologue
11:03: 'Bagaimana mungkin aku melupakan ini?!' — the item or technique he suddenly remembers for moving the coffin isn't named

16:09–17:55: the ambush fight is cut off; the ending (19:27–19:39 'Bunuh dia! … Jika aku tidak membunuhmu, bagaimana saya bisa pergi?') reads like a preview or continuation, so the outcome is uncertain
18:11: the 'Secret Story' segment about the ghost-faced cauldron and the Ruthless Dojo trap is lore narration, not part of this episode's events
